heading.en: Ending one year, starting the next

hook.en: On 1 April the new books are blank, but the shop still has cash, stock and creditors. How do last year's balances enter the new books? Through the *opening entry*.
hook.kn: ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 1 ರಂದು ಹೊಸ ಪುಸ್ತಕಗಳು ಖಾಲಿ, ಆದರೆ ಅಂಗಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಗದು, ದಾಸ್ತಾನು ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಲಗಾರರು ಇದ್ದಾರೆ. ಹಿಂದಿನ ವರ್ಷದ ಬಾಕಿಗಳು ಆರಂಭಿಕ ನಮೂದಿನ ಮೂಲಕ ಹೊಸ ಪುಸ್ತಕ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: At the start of a new year, the balances of assets, liabilities and capital of the previous balance sheet are brought into the new books through one journal *entry*: all asset accounts are debited, and all liability accounts and capital are credited. If capital is not given, it is assets minus liabilities.

body.en: *Closing stock* is the value of unsold goods at the end of the year, valued at cost or net realisable value, whichever is lower. Closing entry: Closing Stock A/c Dr To Trading A/c. It is shown on the credit side of the trading account and on the assets side of the balance sheet. If closing stock appears in the trial balance (purchases already adjusted), it is shown only in the balance sheet.

problem.en: On 1 April 2025, Bharath Stores has: Cash ₹10,000; Stock ₹25,000; Debtors ₹15,000; Furniture ₹20,000; Creditors ₹12,000. Pass the opening entry.

steps.en: Entry: Cash A/c Dr 10,000; Stock A/c Dr 25,000; Debtors A/c Dr 15,000; Furniture A/c Dr 20,000; To Creditors A/c 12,000; To Capital A/c 58,000.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. On 1 April 2025, Bharath Stores has: Cash ₹10,000; Stock ₹25,000; Debtors ₹15,000; Furniture ₹20,000; Creditors ₹12,000. Pass the opening entry.

say.en: Let us work this out together. On 1 April 2025, Bharath Stores has: Cash 10,000 rupees; Stock 25,000 rupees; Debtors 15,000 rupees; Furniture 20,000 rupees; Creditors 12,000 rupees. Pass the opening entry.
Total assets equals 10,000 plus 25,000 plus 15,000 plus 20,000 equals 70,000 rupees.
Capital equals Assets - Liabilities equals 70,000 minus 12,000 equals 58,000 rupees.
Entry: Cash A over c Dr 10,000; Stock A over c Dr 25,000; Debtors A over c Dr 15,000; Furniture A over c Dr 20,000; To Creditors A over c 12,000; To Capital A over c 58,000.
So the answer is Debits 70,000 rupees equals Credits 70,000 rupees; capital 58,000 rupees.
